transcript.text: I've reviewed the publisher's current license, and I need to flag a critical issue with the draft plan. The license requires one individually assigned digital account per student and one authorized print copy per student. It permits 96 print copies for this cohort, but it does NOT permit shared classroom-code access. The draft plan's 80 printed copies and shared classroom-code digital access would put us out of compliance with the license terms.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share something important from my spring pilot with the incoming cohort. I tested the Pathways Grade 6 edition and found it repeats material these students have already mastered. The Pathways Grade 7 edition, on the other hand, matches our required seventh-grade sequence. I recorded these results in my planning notes but haven't sent them to the curriculum office yet. Given that the draft plan proposes the Grade 6 edition, I think this pilot data should factor into our decision before anything is finalized.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to report a requirement from the multilingual services function. My enrollment review identified 14 students who require the Arabic version of the materials, in addition to students who use the Spanish version. The publisher confirmed that both Spanish and Arabic editions are available for this resource, but the language-service request has not yet been added to the adoption plan. We need to ensure these translated editions are included in the final materials order and implementation plan.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Thank you, Ms. Haddad. That's three reports so far — licensing compliance from Ms. Shah, pilot data pointing us toward the Grade 7 edition from Mr. Grant, and multilingual services requiring Arabic and Spanish editions from Ms. Haddad. Before I can close this review meeting and record the settlement, our agenda requires me to hear from every participating function. Could the remaining participating school function please report its implementation requirement now?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to report the implementation requirement from the human-resources function. I've confirmed from the current teacher work agreement that implementation requires two paid preparation sessions for teachers — one on August 10 and one on August 12, 2026. Additionally, based on those preparation requirements, the earliest compliant student launch date is August 24, 2026. I have not yet entered these dates in the curriculum rollout calendar, so the draft plan's single workshop on August 12 and student launch on August 17 would not comply with the teacher work agreement.
transcript.speaker: A5

decisions.digital_access_model: Individually assigned digital accounts, one per student

commitments.detail: Order 96 individually assigned digital accounts (one per student) and 96 authorized print copies (one per student), replacing the draft plan's 80 copies and shared classroom-code access, to comply with the publisher's license terms.

Select the Pathways Grade 7 edition instead of the Grade 6 edition, based on pilot data showing the Grade 6 edition repeats mastered material while Grade 7 matches the required seventh-grade sequence.
Include Spanish and Arabic translated editions in the final materials order and implementation plan to serve the 14 students requiring Arabic versions and students using Spanish versions.

Schedule two paid teacher preparation sessions on August 10 and August 12, 2026, and set the student launch date to August 24, 2026, in compliance with the current teacher work agreement. Update the curriculum rollout calendar accordingly.
